mechanism.claim: At the Friday UTC boundary before weekend liquidity transfer, a high-variation completed seven-day block whose aggressive-flow imbalance accelerates in one direction across at least four of six liquid alt perpetuals reflects broad weekly positioning exhaustion; fade that majority for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: negative strict majority sign of six alt week-over-week taker-flow-imbalance changes
mechanism.why_distinct: CAFAER-12 fades daily alt-and-BTC flow acceleration consensus and is terminal. WCAFER-24 uses a non-overlapping seven-day Friday boundary, requires no BTC flow confirmation, and targets pre-weekend weekly positioning liquidation. It is not a clock filter or subset of CAFAER. AFGI uses a fitted hourly geometry learner.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC completed-week realized-variation strict-prior rank must be at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one weekly Friday 00:05 UTC clock is sparse relative to the Gross9 event roster

features.week: exact bars_binance 1m paths [previous Friday 00:00,current Friday 00:00) UTC; all 10,080 timestamps for all seven symbols
features.flow: sum(2*taker_buy_quote-quote_asset_volume)/sum(quote_asset_volume) per symbol and week; denominator strictly positive
features.acceleration: current valid weekly flow imbalance minus immediately preceding valid Friday-aligned weekly imbalance; gaps make the current week ineligible
features.breadth: at least four of six alt acceleration signs equal one strict sign
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared BTC 1m log(close/open)) over completed week
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank among at most 52 prior valid weeks; minimum 26; current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.availability: Friday 00:00 UTC after all exact weekly paths complete

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent Friday weekly cross-alt positioning-exhaustion mechanism plus user-required high volatility and ex-ante Gross9 clock sparsity

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no breadth, confirmation, week, side, hold, timing, volatility, or subset repair
